headline: DONKEY KONG seats the proven climb
lede: WATCH batch 27 lands: the arcade tower gets a Y-key guide that zigzags the girders, arcs barrels for points and never touches one — then hands you the wheel the moment you press a key.

notes.text: The b27 build died mid-merge-wait on the last session; this one resumed the corpse, re-verified at the exact remote tip (kongcheck 51/51, live watch pilot 271/271) and shipped it as 7d17133.
DonkeyKong's sim now runs whole-tick physics with the dice inside the world state — seeded replays are byte-equal, so the watch driver and a human race the exact same barrel pattern.
The driver obeys arcade doctrine in code: jump candidates only compete near a barrel (no kangarooing the tower) and progress is height-monotone — a mid-ladder credit can never outrank a finished lap.
CI's smoke suite went red because its runner couldn't resolve Ubuntu mirrors mid-chromium-install — a DNS sneeze, not a game bug; static stayed green all the while.

look.text: Press Y on the tower and watch it climb, then steer over
